turns.user_message: We're applying for the Maplewood Municipal Community Garden Grant and need to track our vendor contacts. We've been working with Thornfield Nursery Supply — they're based at 402 Crestline Avenue and have been our main soil and compost provider for three seasons.
turns.assistant_message: Thornfield Nursery Supply at 402 Crestline Avenue sounds like a well-established partner for your grant application. Having a three-season relationship with a vendor demonstrates continuity and reliability, which grant reviewers often look favorably on. Make sure to document the total value of goods they've supplied if you can, as that strengthens the in-kind contribution section of most municipal grant forms.

turns.assistant_message: That's an important operational constraint to note in your grant application — the $350 minimum order and the Tuesday/Thursday delivery window from April 1 through October 31 will directly affect your project timeline and budget planning. turns.assistant_message: That's a critical procedural question — many municipal grant programs do require a co-signature or formal letter of support from the parks department when the project site is on city-leased or city-owned land.
